meta.name: ambientui Design System
meta.description: Serialized master of the ambientui token system. foundation-context.tsx and packages/ui globals.css implement these values; when they diverge, this file wins and the code is corrected. The saved Foundation config selects among them; Figma Sync pushes the result.

accents.$comment: Each accent carries paired foregrounds per mode — the token pair decides on-accent text, never the component. 'ambient' is the assistant accent bridge (--app-blue).

amber.$comment: Light accent — pairs with near-black foreground for WCAG contrast.

grays.$comment: A tint (chroma + hue) applied to every neutral surface token in both modes. 'neutral' is untinted.

radius.$comment: The full radius ramp — every legal corner value, on the same 2/4-starter grid logic as spacing. The saved config picks one; --radius feeds shadcn's derived steps (sm…4xl).

spacingGrids.$comment: The spacing grid is a foundation choice: scale.space.multipliers × unit resolves --ambient-space-1…10. A 4px 'compact' grid was tried and removed — a 2px --spacing collapses real interfaces.

scaling.$comment: Presets map to a concrete root font-size; the rem-based type ramp follows. 100% = 16px.

space.$comment: Resolved as multiplier × the saved spacing grid's unit (default 8px → 2,4,8,16,24,32,40,48,56,64), emitted in rem over the scaling base — scaling is the base layer, every dimension rides it. Tailwind: p-ambient-N, gap-ambient-N; the grid also drives Tailwind's core --spacing (unit ÷ 2).

text.$comment: Keyed 1…9 — the key IS the Figma index, and numbered keys cannot go out of order. Defined in rem so the ramp follows the scaling preset. px values shown at the 16px base.

ambient.$comment: Assistant-layer tokens. --app-blue is the accent bridge (set per mode from foundation.accents[accent].ambient). viz roles are status colors used by processing states.

figma.$comment: Connection is set on the Foundation page (/ds → Foundation) and stored in the saved config as figmaFileUrl. Mapping: figma/tokens-figma-map.json. Procedure: figma/figma-sync.md.
